summary: This bill requires the Department of Education to use an identity fraud detection system to review all Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA) forms for suspicious activity and mandates that colleges verify the identity of students flagged for potential fraud before disbursing federal financial aid.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Higher Education Act of 1965 to implement an identity fraud detection system for FAFSA applications and requires institutions to verify identity for suspicious applications before disbursing federal financial aid. This aims to prevent fraudulent access to federal education funds, which could be seen as reducing wasteful spending within public education funding, thus leading to less spending on public schools if fraud is detected and prevented.
